jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join a Nationwide and Multi-Regional Top Workplace of 2026! Erickson-Hall Construction Co. is an Employee-Owned Company! Our foundation is built around construction done right by people who care, in partnership with people we care about! Please note that this position is based out of Fullerton, CA.

The ideal candidate for our Project Coordinator will support on-site project management by providing administrative support to project management, field supervision, staff and corporate office as required. They will be responsible for general administrative duties, generating reports, logging information, data entry, assisting with functional office set up at the site and other administrative duties as needed. Thorough knowledge of the Field Administrator (FA) duties and ability to perform all FA responsibilities with minimal support necessary.

**Essential Duties**

  

* Assist with ensuring positive customer service is given to our subcontractors, inspectors, fellow team members and owner representatives at the project site.
* Maintain all jobsite files, electronic and paper, ensuring files are up to date and electronically recorded accurately, may maintain Dropbox files as well.
* Ensure all Daily reports are completed and recorded every day for all EHCC and contractor personnel.
* Gather data for the Daily Manpower Report Summary and submit weekly to the corporate office.
* Create meeting agendas and attend project meetings taking meeting notes, consolidating notes and distributing meeting minutes as needed.
* Learn and understand the requirements of workplace safety and report any issues to the project team immediately.
* Ensure accurate recording of information via EHCC master forms for Insurance, Certified Payroll and Contract logs bi-weekly at a minimum then provide to corporate in a timely manner.
* Able to create, maintain, and archive both pre and post construction submittal logs.
* Support the project team in log reporting (e.g. DSA inspections, Procurement, Field, etc.).
* Assist the team entering and distributing RFI’s, ASI’s, and CCD’s and help to maintain files.
* Know about Skilled and Trained workforce requirements for project(s), collect and track required reports for owner submission.
* Assist the Superintendent in coordination of project start up (i.e. trailer mobilization).
* Assist the project team in communications, tracking and logging of punch list items.
* Calendar events and the Pull Planning sessions as directed by site Manager.
* Create and maintain the Equipment Rental Log and submit to accounting and the corporate office weekly.
* May take project photos and uploaded to the company server on a weekly basis.
* Be familiar with plans and specifications and able to help gather information as needed with direction.
* Create and maintain post-construction submittal log with assistance: owner training, extra stock, as-built drawings and responsible for closeout documents for project turnover.
* Distribution of project submittals through review/approval process.
* Assists the team in the tracking and logging of items for LEED specific projects.

* Assist immediate supervisor with obtaining subcontractor Cost Proposals and learning about SOV Forms.
* Learn and gather data for Contractor & Owner billings.
* Learn, assist and process information about Change Orders

* Perform other office functions as needed.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* Two or more year(s) of work experience in construction administrative support preferred
* Advanced understanding of MS Office, Bluebeam/Adobe, and data entry skills necessary
* Ability to work well with others, meet deadlines and adapt to changes in priorities
* Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy

  

Benefits:

  

* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Profit-Sharing
* 100% employer-paid Health/Dental premiums for team members
* Generous Vacation and Sick Time off
* Nine (9) Paid Holidays - Including your Birthday!
* 100% employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Long Term Disability insurance
* Retirement plans with company contribution

* Subsidized tuition on Child Care
* Health/Dependent care FSA's
* Making a difference in the communities you serve

  

Acknowledgments:

  

Erickson-Hall Construction Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any of the following, whether actual or perceived or based upon identification or association: race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth (and related medical conditions), physical or mental disability, genetic information, sex, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, marital status, registered domestic partner status, military status, veteran status, political activity or affiliation or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator**

We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and personable **Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator** to work closely with the owner of an established textbook wholesale business and real estate investment portfolio.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys variety, takes initiative, communicates well, and can help keep multiple businesses and projects organized and moving forward.

A **friendly, outgoing, and open personality is extremely important**. You will regularly communicate with customers, vendors, employees, contractors, property managers, tenants, and other professionals, so we are looking for someone who is naturally pleasant, confident, and comfortable dealing with people.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Assist with the day-to-day operations of the textbook wholesale business
* Help manage emails, phone calls, scheduling, follow-ups, and correspondence
* Communicate professionally with customers, schools, vendors, and suppliers
* Follow up on orders, purchasing, shipping, invoices, and outstanding issues
* Coordinate with warehouse employees and help keep projects and priorities organized
* Assist with real estate investments and property-management matters
* Communicate with contractors, property managers, tenants, attorneys, lenders, and vendors
* Track deadlines, documents, payments, renewals, repairs, and ongoing projects
* Research vendors, properties, products, pricing, and other business matters as needed
* Prepare spreadsheets, reports, letters, and basic business documents
* Help organize records, files, contracts, invoices, and other information
* Handle miscellaneous administrative and operational projects for the owner
* Follow through on assignments without needing constant supervision

**The ideal candidate is someone who:**

* Has a very friendly, professional, and approachable personality
* Is highly organized and pays attention to details
* Communicates clearly and confidently by phone and email
* Has strong common sense and problem-solving skills
* Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told every next step
* Is comfortable juggling multiple projects and changing priorities
* Is reliable, honest, and discreet with confidential business information
* Is comfortable following up repeatedly when something needs to get done
* Has good computer skills, including Excel, email, and general office software
* Learns quickly and is willing to take ownership of new responsibilities

Experience in **operations, executive assistance, real estate, property management, bookkeeping, purchasing, logistics, or customer service** is helpful, but personality, intelligence, reliability, and willingness to learn are equally important.

This position has the potential to grow significantly for the right person. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted part of the business and take on increasing responsibility over time.

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Position:** Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  
**Compensation:** $52,000 to $60,000 Depending on Experience and other factors

Pay: $52,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Corporate Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### ***Elevate Your Career with a Dynamic Corporate Marketing Role***

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION:**

Promote awareness of the company, hotel, and restaurant/bar/outlets images internally and externally. Create and execute social media posts and campaigns as well as respond to guest comments on these channels. Help develop marketing materials and assemble information packages (e.g., brochures, promotional materials, maps, etc.) for promotional events: property tours, and conferences. Prepare or edit letters, invitations, monthly and quarterly internal e-newsletters, press reports, and news releases, using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software. Make updates to property website. Assist with photo and video shoots. Respond to all daily general media inquiries or refer to an appropriate spokesperson. Monitor media coverage and other external factors to identify potential or actual problem areas and opportunities. Support media/influencer relations outreach efforts and other activities to bolster the property's reputation and image in the community. Coordinate on-property visits from media/influencers, including reservations, amenities, special requests, and dining. File and update press database, digital library, and press clippings.

Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answers telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats. Move, lift, carry, pull and place objects weighing less or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors.

The ideal candidate will be excited to take on a multitude of projects from start to finish.

**WORK REQUIREMENTS:**

**Brand Stewardship & Multi-Property Alignment**

* Ensuring all digital collateral, print media, and signage strictly adhere to brand guidelines.
* Update marketing calendars, promotional asset distribution, and asset libraries across multiple hotel properties or food & beverage (F&B) outlets.
* Help update brochure and property collateral materials, including all property imaging work (e.g., signage).
* Assist e-commerce with updating content on all web sites (e.g. hotel, restaurant, etc.).

**Digital Marketing & Content Creation**

* Creating, scheduling, and analyzing organic social content across platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, Meta).
* Live content capture during media events or site activations when required.
* Track articles on operations and property events.
* Working knowledge of basic design tools like **Canva** or **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, InDesign) to adjust collateral, flyers, menu updates, and digital signage.

**Website & Online Travel Agency (OTA) Maintenance**

* Updating copy, package offers, photo galleries, and landing pages on property websites.
* Regularly checking local listings (Google Business Profile, TripAdvisor) and third-party OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com) to ensure high-resolution photos, amenity lists, and descriptions are accurate.

**Public Relations, Events & Partnerships**

* Coordinating site visits, hosting media dinners, drafting press release distribution lists, and organizing influencer itineraries.
* Assisting with corporate events, property milestone celebrations, trade shows, and community involvement initiatives.
* Evaluate new marketing opportunities for the property.
* Ensure property is represented on all quality internet sites that have the potential of providing business.

**Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales & Marketing Opportunities**

* Build and strengthen relationships with existing and new travel writers and local media to ensure future exposure; conducting site inspections with visiting journalists and handling calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
* Develop relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities and additional revenue; coordinating community service activities in concert with the public image and needs of the hotel.

**ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES**

* Report all suspicious people or activities and hazardous or unsafe conditions to the security department.
* Respond to guest questions. Provide guest assistance, direction and information as requested when working in public areas.
* Ensure that property follows all corporate marketing guidelines.
* Represent the hotel at various functions and trade shows.
* Participation and network through key organizations.
* Available to work at various days and times, as required. Includes, weekends, Holidays and evenings.
* Demonstrate an awareness of personal strengths and areas for professional improvement; willing to learn from others; acting independently to improve and increase skills and knowledge.
* Share learnings, innovations, and best practices with others.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships with peers and superiors.
* Perform any other reasonable duties as required by the Senior Corporate Marketing Manager & other supervisors.
* Travel, hospitality or luxury goods background preferred
* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Business Administration, or related major.
* 2-years’ experience in public relations, communications, advertising or related professional area.
* Demonstrated proficiency and accuracy in using MS Office products such as Word, Excel, and Outlo

jobs.title: Fulfillment Coordinator- Retail Accounts
jobs.description:
Description:

**Who we are**

Jonathan Louis is a furniture manufacturer based in California. Our team of builders, planners, coordinators and craftspeople, many of whom have been with us since day one, work together to deliver high-quality furniture to retailers across the country. We’re also moms, dads, sisters and brothers, and we treat each other like family.

With countless configurations, colors, styles and fabrics, every order matters, and it takes a dependable team behind the scenes to get the right product to the right customer on time.

**Our mission**

To design and build quality furniture for the home that provides value and reflects today’s lifestyle.

**Our values**

* Integrity
* Quality
* Respect
* Teamwork
* Fun
* Efficiency
* Compassion

**The role**

As our **Fulfillment Coordinator – Retail Accounts**, you’ll be the go-to connection between our retailers and the teams that get parts and fabric swatches out the door. You’ll track every request from receipt to delivery, keep retailers and our Sales team informed before they have to ask, and solve problems quickly when something goes off track. It’s a mix of customer communication, ERP and Excel reporting, and hands-on shipping.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Track retailer parts and swatch requests from receipt throughshipment and delivery confirmation
* Keep JL retailers updated on order status, availability, ship dates, tracking, delays and resolutions
* Give Sales and Retail Accounts clear visibility into open requests, expected ship dates and potential concerns
* Build and share recurring open-order, aging, shipment-status and exception reports using our ERP system and Excel
* Spot shortages and delays early, coordinate fixes, and reset expectations before the customer has to ask
* Partner with Parts, Swatches, Mexico operations, Purchasing, Inventory and Logistics to confirm availability and shipping schedules
* Keep order, shipment and tracking records accurate in the ERP system
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies, damaged or missing shipments and incomplete requests, escalating when needed
* Coordinate shipping documents, labels, packaging and carrier pickups, and pitch in on hands-on fulfillment

Help improve reports, tracking processes and communication so retailers get answers faster

Requirements:

**What you bring to the team**

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree or coursework in business, logistics or supply chain preferred
* 2+ years in customer service, order management, fulfillment, logistics or operations support; B2B or retail account experience strongly preferred
* Confident, professional communication with customers by phone and email, especially when orders are delayed
* Strong organization, attention to detail and ability to juggle many open orders and follow-ups
* Intermediate Excel (filtering, sorting, trackers, status reports) preferred; Outlook and standard office software required
* ERP or order-management system experience preferred; Infor/Syteline a plus
* Ability to spot discrepancies, investigate issues and coordinate solutions across departments
* Comfortable switching between desk work and hands-on shipping
* Experience with furniture, parts, fabric swatches or retailer service a plus, but not required
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred, to work with our Mexico operations

**Why you’ll love it here**

* A stable company where teamwork and follow-through are valued
* A role where you see the direct impact of your work on our retail partners
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* [401(k) with company match / paid time off / paid holidays / employee furniture discount
* Teammates who have built their careers here, many since day one

*Jonathan Louis International is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and local ordinances.*

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Summary**
===========

The Project Coordinator helps keep commercial kitchen projects moving from kickoff through closeout. Working with Project Managers, Project Executives, and the broader team, the Coordinator tracks schedules, documentation, vendors, and follow-up. As experience grows, Coordinators may take day-to-day ownership of assigned projects with guidance on technical, contractual, and financial decisions.


We value initiative, reliability, curiosity, and comfort with technology over prior industry experience. This hands-on role is for someone who enjoys solving problems, follows through, and wants to build a career in project management. Training and support are provided; no foodservice equipment experience is required.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

* Participate in project handoffs and kickoffs, coordinating next steps with Project Administration, Supply Chain, and Field teams.
* Track schedules, milestones, and open items in Airtable; proactively flag deadlines, risks, and missing information.
* Keep drawings, specifications, submittals, correspondence, and shared project folders organized and up to date.
* Learn to review plans, equipment schedules, and specifications; flag questions and potential scope issues to a Project Manager or Project Executive.
* Organize and update AutoQuotes (AQ) files to support equipment scope and purchasing accuracy.
* Track submittals, requests for information (RFIs), change orders, and outstanding decisions; follow up on responses.
* Coordinate procurement handoffs and purchase order reviews; track lead times, equipment deliveries, and shipping status.
* Assist Project Administration with billing milestones and stored material documentation.
* Coordinate schedules, deliveries, installation, and startup with customers, contractors, vendors, and installers; escalate issues as needed.
* As skills develop, lead day-to-day coordination on selected projects with PM/PX oversight, including follow-up, punch lists, and closeout.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Strong work ethic, dependability, and a demonstrated habit of following through on commitments
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize and track several moving pieces at once
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions and following up with others
* Comfort with computers, spreadsheets, and learning new software and digital workflows
* Resourceful problem-solving mindset; takes initiative, accepts feedback, and knows when to escalate issues
* Eagerness to learn project management; no prior construction or foodservice experience required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience coordinating tasks, schedules, orders, or deliveries in any industry
* Familiarity with drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, or change orders
* Experience with AutoQuotes (AQ), Bluebeam, Airtable, or similar systems
* Exposure to commercial kitchen equipment, manufacturers, vendors, or field installations

**Supervisory Responsibility**
==============================

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

**A LITTLE ABOUT BEEK**

beek is a luxury footwear and accessories brand based in Newport Beach, California, founded in 2014 by two friends, Birgit and Kenna, who share a love for beautiful design, quality leather, and exceptional craftsmanship.

Our philosophy is simple: create timeless, beautifully made pieces that feel as incredible as they look. We believe in quality over quantity, craftsmanship over trends, and designing pieces that only get better with age. What began as a collection of leather footwear has grown to include handbags and accessories, all with the same commitment to thoughtful design, beautiful materials, and uncompromising comfort.

Giving back has also been part of our story since day one. Every pair of shoes sold helps provide meals to children in need through our longtime partnership with Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County. It's a part of our business that means a great deal to us.

**And the team behind beek?**

We're a close-knit group of creative, hardworking people who genuinely enjoy what we do. We're collaborative, entrepreneurial, and passionate about the details. We move quickly, wear a lot of hats, and believe that great ideas can come from anyone. We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

We're continuing to grow and are always excited to bring talented, thoughtful people into the mix.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Social Coordinator owns beek's organic presence on Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, leads content creation for these channels and the blog, and manages our TikTok Shop and Instagram Shop. You'll plan the calendar, produce and source creative, attend every photo and video shoot, and run the UGC engine across organic and paid.

You'll partner daily with the Influencer Specialist to find the best-performing creators and content. Then you'll pass the winners to the email and web teams so great content works across every channel.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social calendar & creative (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)**

* Own the monthly social calendar, aligned with launches, promotions, email/SMS sends and seasonal moments.

* Brief and art-direct creative with the design team, and shoot and edit short-form content yourself when needed.
* Manage community engagement: comments, DMs and responses, with customer service support.
* Track trends and platform changes, and test new formats quickly.

**Instagram giveaways**

* Come up with and run Instagram giveaways that grow followers and engagement, solo or with partner brands and creators.
* Plan each one from start to finish: prize, partners, entry mechanics, timing, creative and captions.
* Pick and contact winners, coordinate prize fulfillment, and report on followers gained, engagement and how many new followers stick around.

**Content creation & shoots**

* Build a seasonal and monthly content plan covering social, the blog and social commerce, with shot lists for each launch and campaign.
* Attend all photo and video shoots to capture social-first content: behind-the-scenes, short-form video, styling clips and founder content.
* Organize, edit and deliver shoot content quickly so it's ready for launch.

**TikTok Shop & Instagram Shop**

* Manage TikTok Shop and Instagram Shop day to day: product listings, catalog sync, pricing, promotions and inventory accuracy.
* Tag products in posts, Reels, TikToks and Stories so content is shoppable.
* Plan shop promotions, including flash deals, launch offers and seasonal sales, alongside the brand calendar.
* Manage TikTok Shop affiliate creators with the Influencer Specialist, including samples, commission rates and content tracking.
* Handle shop operations with customer service and fulfillment: orders, returns, reviews and seller performance scores.
* Report on shop sales and conversion, and test what drives purchases.

**Blog**

* Own the blog calendar: styling guides, product stories, brand and founder stories, and SEO-driven content.
* Write or brief posts, and optimize them for search and conversion (keywords, internal links, product links).
* Repurpose blog content for social, email and Pinterest.

**UGC content (organic and paid)**

* Source, collect and organize UGC from customers, creators and reviews.
* Secure usage rights and keep a searchable UGC library.
* Curate UGC for organic posting and deliver top assets to paid social for ads and whitelisting.
* Review paid performance with the ads team to learn which hooks and formats convert.

**Partnering with the Influencer Specialist**

* Review creator content performance together each week to identify top influencers and content.
* Feed social insights back into influencer briefs and creator selection.
* Coordinate reposts, collabs and co-posted content with creators.

**Content handoff to email & web**

* Pass top-performing social, UGC, shoot and influencer content to the email and web teams on a regular cadence.
* Deliver assets in the right sizes and formats, with usage rights and credits confirmed.
* Keep a shared content hub so every team can find approved, on-brand assets.

**Must-haves**

* 2–4 years managing social for a DTC, fashion, lifestyle or ecommerce brand.
* Deep knowledge of Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, including formats, algorithms and trends.
* Hands-on experience managing TikTok Shop and/or Instagram Shop, including listings, promotions and product tagging.

* Experience sourcing UGC and managing usage rights.
* Organized: you run a calendar and hit deadlines across several stakeholders.
* Comfortable with analytics: you read native insights and turn results into next steps.

This person will take pride in maximizing the effectiveness of our marketing efforts and will play a critical role in growing the business. If you have a ton of smarts, are equally as fun, and thrive on teamwork and winning… this is the place for you! This is an entry-level, full-time position based in our corporate office in Irvine, CA, following a hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. Spanish fluency is required.

**The Roland DGA Family**  
Roland DGA Corporation serves North and South America as the sales, marketing, distribution and service arm for Roland DG Corporation of Hamamatsu, Japan. Roland DG is a worldwide leader in wide-format inkjet printers for the sign, textile and personalization markets; engravers for awards, giftware, signage and direct part marking; and desktop 3D printers and milling machines for the dental CAD/CAM, product prototyping and medical industries.

Roland DGA is a nine-time winner of the Orange County Register Top Workplace Award. We prioritize our positive culture and a creative, team-oriented environment, and offer an attractive benefits package including continuing education and 401k matching. If you are goal oriented and driven to grow both personally and professionally, then this is the company for you.

**Position Purpose**  
Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Customer Development, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) engages with new and existing sales prospects across North and South America through channels such as telephone, email, and web chat. The SDR generates new sales opportunities for our sales channels and follows up on leads created by Roland DGA through trade shows, advertisements, web forms, and CRM mining.

In addition, the SDR conducts regular outbound campaigns and leverages lead-generation platforms to identify new opportunities. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management teams to maximize prospect engagement, strengthen the sales pipeline, and increase closed-won rates.

**Essential Functions & Basic Duties**

**Lead Management & CRM**

* Manage and document all sales opportunities in a CRM, ensuring accurate tracking and timely updates.
* Handle inbound pre-sales inquiries via phone, email, web chat, and social media to generate qualified opportunities.
* Follow up on dealer-distributed opportunities to confirm prospect engagement, purchase outcomes, or pending status.
* Close out opportunities in a CRM once they have reached the end of their lifecycle.
* Set up new customer accounts and update contact profiles to maintain clean and accurate CRM data.
* Utilize CRM and database-mining platforms to build prospect lists and support outreach initiatives.

**Sales Development & Outreach**

* Manage the Sales Development email queue and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.
* Execute targeted communication campaigns to customers and prospects, promoting sales initiatives, special offers, and equipment updates.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product Management on lead and opportunity distribution, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Assist with pre-sales email outreach and post-show lead processing to maximize event ROI.

**Relationship Building & Representation**

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with prospects, customers, and dealer partners.
* Participate in industry trade shows and educational events, representing Roland DGA professionally.
* Present sales materials at corporate and dealer training sessions to support product and sales enablement.

**Reporting & Professionalism**

* Generate and deliver Sales and Marketing reports to support business insights.
* Uphold Roland’s highest professional and ethical standards as outlined in the Employee Handbook.

**Performance Measurements**  
**Lead & Opportunity Management**

* Consistently qualify and convert sales leads in a timely and accurate manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of activities and demonstrate strong product knowledge in all customer interactions.

Customer Engagement

* Drive consistent outbound communication and follow-up with customers and prospects.
* Take full ownership of assigned inquiries, ensuring professional resolution and follow-through.

**Collaboration & Team Contribution**

* Actively support departmental goals and contribute to the achievement of company objectives.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Product Management.

**Task Execution & Accountability**

* Complete daily, weekly, monthly, and special assignments within established timelines.
* Demonstrate accuracy, reliability, and attention to detail in all deliverables.

**Professional Standards**

* Receive positive peer feedback during performance reviews as an indicator of teamwork and professionalism.
* Adhere to company policies and guidelines, including attendance, punctuality, and ethical standards as outlined in Roland’s Employee Handbook.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years’ experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, or Marketing.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Collaborative team player who builds positive relationships across departments.
* Knowledge of Sales Development processes and systems is a plus.
* Familiarity with wide-format printing, cutting, engraving, and/or 3D milling technologies is a plus.
* Spanish language fluency (spoken and written) is required for this role.

**SALARY RANGE:** $55,000 - $60,000 +

We are seeking a professional, personable, and highly organized Receptionist to serve as the welcoming face and first point of contact for our firm. This is an important client-facing role that helps shape each client’s first impression and ensures a professional, responsive, and welcoming experience from the moment they contact or visit our office.

As our Receptionist, you will be at the center of our day-to-day front office operations, welcoming clients and guests, answering and directing incoming calls, coordinating communications, and providing essential administrative support to our team.

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, communicates with warmth and professionalism, and takes pride in creating an exceptional experience for clients. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities while remaining organized, attentive, and composed in a fast-paced professional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for clients, prospective clients, visitors, and callers, creating a warm and professional first impression.
* Answer, screen, and direct incoming calls and respond promptly to general inquiries by phone, email, and in person.
* Maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming environment throughout the reception area, conference rooms, kitchen, and shared office spaces.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, deliveries, shipping, parking validations, visitor logs, and front-office security procedures.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, appointments, and provide general administrative support, including filing, copying, and document preparation.

jobs.title: Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice & Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part-time **Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

**About JDC**

JDC is a non-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job**

The Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self-represented litigants in two ways: (1) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible but must be performed during regular business hours, Monday through Friday. The schedule should remain reasonably consistent from week to week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. The Coordinator also assists with outreach, database upkeep, development of resources, and improvement of best practices.

The Coordinator works at a fast pace using multiple computer applications, to schedule clients, and communicate with the Project attorneys. Command of Microsoft Office applications is essential for success in the position.

This position is not eligible for benefits and is not an attorney position.

**Education & Experience:**

· Relevant education, training, and experience to perform the essential duties of the position

· Experience in the legal field is helpful but not required

**Skills & Requirements:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
* Ability to toggle between communication applications at a fast pace
* Professional verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to interact with clients courteously and with cultural humility
* Efficient self-starter with strong organization and time management skills
* Careful attention to detail
* Demonstrated interest in working with diverse, low-income communities
* Bilingual language skills are a plus

**Why Work For Us**

The Project team offers a small, supportive work environment within a larger organization and the opportunity to collaborate with a progressive work culture and a diverse staff. Additionally, we are a mission and values-based organization.

To find out more about JDC, please visit our website at www.sfbar.org/jdc

Please submit your resume along with cover letter to https://secure.saashr.com/ta/i.BAS.careers?ApplyToJob=755499013&full\_apply=&jobid=755499013

JDC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We conduct all employment-related activities without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation or any other classification protected by applicable Local, State or Federal employment discrimination laws.

jobs.title: Music School Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Music School Program Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for CSMA’s Music School. The primary responsibility of this position is driving enrollment for both current and prospective students. Fulfillment of this responsibility requires coordinating faculty schedules, breaks, and availability using strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills.

A secondary responsibility of this role is handling logistics for all Music School recitals. This includes managing event scheduling, ensuring necessary resources and equipment are provided, and attending recitals in person to facilitate the needs of faculty, student performers, and guests.

Reporting to the Music School Director, this position also works in alignment with the Music Classes & Faculty Supervisor to handle faculty needs and logistics. This is a key support role that requires high interpersonal resilience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to provide professional support to faculty.

**Primary Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Enrollment Coordination:** Actively drive the enrollment process by managing new inquiries, conducting follow-up communication via phone and email, and navigating registration software. The priority in this operational area is to provide the level of follow-through necessary to maximize student enrollment and retention.
* **Faculty Schedules & Support:** Manage faculty teaching schedules, availability, and breaks with high precision. Optimize room schedules, resolve calendar conflicts, and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned faculty.
* **Recital Coordination:** Lead all logistical and administrative operations for student recitals (~40/semester), including communications, resources, and program creation. Responsible for in-person attendance and support at recitals, which requires working some weekends.
* **Student Lifecycle Support:** Coordinate the administrative logistics and success of trial lessons, teacher transfers, make-ups, and withdrawals, collaborating closely with faculty to ensure accurate record-keeping and process completion.
* **Customer Service:** Serve as a front-end representative, welcoming families and delivering exceptional customer service to ensure a positive and personable experience for students and parents.
* **Professional Composure:** Maintain a warm and helpful demeanor while supporting faculty, parents, and students. This role requires the ability to remain objective and professional when navigating interactions with assertive personalities, managing family concerns, or addressing faculty needs under pressure.
* **Student Services Collaboration:** Partner with the Student Services team as a key collaborator to ensure student data is accurate and that families experience a smooth transition from inquiry to active enrollment.
* **Departmental Assistance:** Provide occasional administrative support to cross-program areas and events, including the Music Classes program, as requested.

**Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in administration, arts management, or related field. A music degree is not required.
* **Working experience:**  2+ years of work experience with customer service, scheduling, or a relevant area. Strong background in music, music education, or instrumental/voice study to evaluate student needs and operate effectively within a music school.
* **Process & Detail Orientation:** Exceptional attention to detail and strong multitasking skills, with a proven ability to navigate complex, multi-step workflows. Proficient in managing information across multiple resources simultaneously, including registration systems, calendars, spreadsheets, and communication channels, to execute operations without error.
* **Event Coordination:** Strong real-time problem-solving skills to ensure seamless recital operations. Adept at assisting faculty and attendees during recitals while working collaboratively with concert hall and facility staff to manage logistics.
* **Independent Operation:** Ability to work independently and solve problems in real time when other administrative personnel are not available. Must remain calm and resourceful to effectively resolve unexpected logistical or client issues without immediate managerial oversight.
* **Professional Maturity & Composure:** Professional maturity, ability to remain calm, composed, and solutions-focused when navigating high-pressure situations, tight deadlines, or challenging interactions.
* **Google Workspace & Technology:** Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sites, and Sheets), alongside a strong adaptability for quickly mastering new registration software, technology, and collaborative administrative tools..
* **Customer Relations & Sales:** Highly personable, building connections across phone, email, and in-person communications. Pairs a warm, accommodating approach with strong drive and enthusiasm to engage families, prioritize inquiries, and grow student enrollment.

**Schedule & Physical Requirements**

**Schedule**

* Tuesday - Friday (12:00 pm - 8:30 pm) & Saturday (9:00 am - 5:30 pm).
* Occasional weekend availability required to support recitals and special events.

**Physical Requirements**

Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is hiring an ETA Communications Production Coordinator to support the Energy Technologies Area’s communications operations. The role involves coordinating communications projects, tracking requests and deadlines, proofreading and editing content, preparing multimedia assets, publishing content across digital platforms, and ensuring quality and accuracy.

Responsibilities also include maintaining and reviewing websites and intranet content, coordinating seminars and newsletters, supporting social media and internal communications, monitoring digital platforms and performance metrics, and assisting with purchase order tracking.

A typical day may include editing and publishing science articles, preparing digital newsletters, coordinating seminar announcements, responding to communications requests, reviewing websites for outdated content, and helping staff produce high-quality internal and external communications.

**We’re here for the same mission, to bring science solutions to the world. Join our team and YOU will play a supporting role in our goal to address global challenges! Have a high level of impact and work for an organization associated with 17 Nobel Prizes!**

***Why join Berkeley Lab?***

We invest in our employees by offering a total rewards package you can count on:

  

* Exceptional health and retirement benefits, including pension or 401K-style plans
  
* A culture where you’ll belong - we are invested in our teams!
  
* In addition to accruing vacation and sick time, we also have a Winter Holiday Shutdown every year.
  
* Parental bonding leave (for both mothers and fathers)
  
* Pet insurance

* Copy edit and proofread articles, newsletters, presentations, and internal and external communications, often on tight deadlines.
  
* Prepare images and multimedia for digital content. With guidance, find and size archived photos or stock imagery, and help manage digital asset files.
  
* Perform digital production quality control checks and needed adjustments prior to posting ‘go live’
  
* Perform monthly ETA web content audits for outdated or irrelevant content and alert appropriate content owners of outdated or irrelevant content
  
* Coordinate reviews of the monthly distribution of ETA’s Internal Newsletter
  
* Help coordinate and track media/reporter requests
  
* Assist with drafting, reviewing, and posting on social media channels with relevant and timely content.
  
* Assist with tracking website and social media analytics.
  
* Help train and guide ETA staff who edit ETA websites. With guidance, handle client communications as needed.

  

**Communications Production Coordinator Level 2 will:**

  

* Perform the responsibilities above with minimal guidance, working independently and proactively to manage priorities, resolve issues, and engage with external stakeholders on projects as needed.

  

**We are looking for Communications Production Coordinator Level 1:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in English, communications, or journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  
* Tech savvy and experience in the use of internal and external communications tools and platforms (such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Google Suite, social media, and commonly used content management systems such as WordPress and Drupal, and other digital platforms).

* Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize work assignments, work collaboratively with others, adjust schedules based on changing requirements, and work well under pressure/during tight deadlines.
  
* Demonstrated excellence in all areas of customer service.

  

**In addition to above, Communications Production Coordinator Level 2, will have:**

* Ability to successfully work as part of a team or independently

  

**Desired skills/knowledge:**

  

* Experience in digital production, writing and editing, organizational communications, and/or journalism.
  
* Experience posting text and multimedia content to commonly used digital platforms and content management systems.
  
* Experience in the use of digital analytics and online communications tools and platforms (such as Google Analytics, Constant Contact or other digital email platforms, Cision or other news media monitoring and reporting platforms, etc.).
  
* Experience with data analytics and reporting.
  
* Experience with social media in an institutional setting.
  
* Experience within a national laboratory or other science-based organization.

  

**Additional information:**

  

* **Application date:**Priority consideration will be given to candidates who apply by December 3, 2026. Applications will be accepted until the job posting is removed.

jobs.description:
**Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.**

**About Trial Library**

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

### **About the Role**

Reporting to the Head of Payer Strategy, the Associate Project Manager will support Trial Library’s payer and employer partnerships and make sure partners have a smooth experience from launch onward. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that requires cross-functional collaboration. You will be the day-to-day point of contact for active health plan and employer partners and keep every partner informed, supported, and engaged.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for active health plan and employer partners: keep regular communication going, share updates, and gather feedback.
* Lead implementation and launch of new partnerships, including eligibility file setup, referral pathways, member communication plans, and integration with existing care management or benefits programs.
* Own all partner inquiries and troubleshooting, resolving issues quickly.
* Work cross functionally with the operations, provider partnerships team, and products team leading efforts to ensure all client deliverables are executed on time and with superior quality in mind.
* Deliver timely, accurate reports to partners on Trial Library’s performance, including member outreach, engagement, navigation, trial matching, and enrollment outcomes.
* Help the Head of Payer Strategy develop value and ROI reporting that shows the clinical and economic impact of partnerships.
* Prepare and lead partner presentations, from program launch to quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations.
* Oversee all partner-facing materials, including member communications, benefit collateral, co-branded outreach, and performance documentation.
* Track account health and flag chances to expand or renew to the Head of Payer Strategy.
* Help build scalable processes for partner onboarding, reporting, and account management.
* Make sure partner communications and data handling follow HIPAA and contract requirements.
* Stay current on Trial Library’s product offering and value for health plans, employers, and their members.

### **Your Requirements:**

* 3–5 years of experience in health plan operations, employer benefits, care management, healthcare account management, or customer success.
* Experience with payer or employer reporting needs, such as engagement and utilization metrics, outcomes, and value or ROI reporting.
* Familiarity with health plan operations, employer-sponsored benefits, or population health programs.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and handling protected health information (PHI).
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of professionalism with internal and external stakeholders.
* An analytical approach, comfortable using data to drive action and tell a clear story.
* A bias toward action, stepping in before issues arise.
* Able to work autonomously.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or a high-growth startup.
* Familiarity with oncology, clinical trials, precision medicine, or patient navigation.
* Experience supporting value-based care programs or payer partnerships.
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Looker).

### **Compensation & On-Site Requirement**

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. The salary range for this position is $108,000–$135,000 per year and reflects a good faith estimate of base pay for candidates working in this location. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

### **Why Trial Library**

* Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
* High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
* Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
* Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

### **Our Core Values**

* Ally is our favorite moniker
* The broadest reach is worth the effort
* Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
* Fearless advocates for representation in research
* Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products
* Taking initiative is actually giving
* We are accountable for the experience of patients and providers
* Empathy and humility are the real dynamic duo

### **Our Benefits & Perks**

* Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, along with disability, life, and supplemental insurance options designed to support your overall well-being.

**Company Overview**

Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. You will be the person who knows what is actually happening with our accounts: where adoption is strong, where it is stalling, where the political winds are shifting, and where there is room to expand and upsell.

You will work directly with senior stakeholders inside utility companies, and municipal agencies, alongside our internal Product, Sales, Outreach, and Implementation teams. * **Feed the institutional knowledge base.** What you learn in the field belongs to the whole company. Document it and share it so the next person does not have to relearn it.

  + Define next steps, assign responsibilities and hold internal teams and suppliers accountable.
  + Anticipate production challenges and dependencies – venues, fabrication, AV, logistics and permits – and propose clear solutions early.
  + Translate client goals into actionable plans for creative, production and logistics teams.

jobs.description:
**IGY SIX Consulting** is recruiting on behalf of **Vertex Security** for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Financial Operations SpecialistAbout the Role

**About the Role**

Vertex Security is seeking a hands-on Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist to take ownership of day-to-day accounts receivable, bookkeeping, financial administration, and related back-office responsibilities.

This is not a narrowly defined accounting position.

Vertex is a growing small business where the person in this role will be expected to manage established financial processes, investigate discrepancies, communicate with customers and vendors, respond to administrative and government correspondence, and independently work through issues that arise during normal business operations.

The right person is organized, resourceful, comfortable making decisions within their area of responsibility, and able to take an issue from identification through resolution without requiring step-by-step direction.

The position reports directly to company leadership and will receive training on Vertex-specific systems, customers, processes, and historical practices during the onboarding period. The expectation is that the successful candidate will progressively take ownership of these responsibilities and become increasingly independent.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAccounts Receivable & Collections**

* Manage the full accounts receivable process from invoice creation through payment and reconciliation.
* Prepare and send customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Monitor aging reports and proactively follow up on outstanding balances.
* Contact customers regarding overdue invoices and resolve payment delays.
* Investigate billing disputes, missing approvals, incorrect balances, and other collection issues.
* Coordinate with project managers and operations teams when billing questions require internal clarification.
* Apply customer payments and reconcile customer accounts.
* Maintain accurate documentation of collection activity, commitments, and follow-up dates.
* Identify accounts requiring escalation and present leadership with the issue, supporting facts, and recommended next step.

**Bookkeeping & Financial Operations**

* Maintain accurate financial records within QuickBooks Online.
* Perform bank and credit-card reconciliations.
* Research and resolve discrepancies between QuickBooks, CRM systems, bank records, and other company systems.
* Support monthly close and ensure required reconciliations and reporting are completed on schedule.
* Assist with sales-tax preparation and other recurring financial requirements.
* Maintain accurate transaction records and supporting documentation.
* Identify discrepancies or unusual activity and investigate the cause before making corrections.
* Support accounts payable responsibilities as the position expands.

**Administrative & Compliance Responsibilities**

* Review and manage company correspondence requiring action or research.
* Respond to notices from government agencies, insurance providers, vendors, customers, and other outside parties.
* Track licenses, registrations, insurance certificates, renewals, and compliance deadlines.
* Research unfamiliar administrative issues and determine the appropriate path toward resolution.
* Maintain organized records and documentation for financial, administrative, insurance, and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate DMV, fleet, insurance, and other general business matters as needed.
* Work with outside professionals such as accountants, insurance representatives, attorneys, or government agencies when appropriate.

**How Success Is Measured**

Success in this role means more than completing assigned tasks.

The person in this position should be able to:

* Maintain accurate and current financial records.
* Keep accounts receivable moving and prevent issues from aging unnecessarily.
* Complete reconciliations and monthly financial processes on schedule.
* Recognize discrepancies and investigate them independently.
* Track deadlines and ensure commitments are not missed.
* Prioritize competing responsibilities based on urgency, financial impact, and risk.
* Communicate problems early rather than allowing them to become emergencies.
* Present leadership with facts and recommended solutions rather than simply passing problems upward.
* Develop systems, checklists, and processes that improve accuracy and efficiency.

**Ideal Background**

* 3+ years of experience in a small-business environment with direct ownership of AP, AR, bookkeeping, or day-to-day financial operations.
* Experience serving as the primary or sole person responsible for core bookkeeping or accounting workflows is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.
* Experience managing the full accounts receivable cycle, including invoicing, collections, payment application, aging reports, and reconciliations.
* Experience handling accounts payable, vendor payments, and bank and/or credit-card reconciliations.
* Comfortable working directly with business owners or senior leadership and independently managing day-to-day financial priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar issues, resolve discrepancies, and bring forward a recommended solution rather than simply escalating the problem.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
* Comfortable communicating with customers regarding overdue balances, billing disputes, and payment issues.
* Construction, project-based billing, AIA billing, or progress-billing experience is helpful but not required.
* Experience dealing with insurance, government correspondence, licenses, registrations, or similar administrative matters is a plus.

**“How do I solve this?”**

rather than:

**“Who should I give this problem to?”**

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ZEGNA**  
  
The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. Part of the Ermenegildo Zegna Group, the brand remains true to the values of its visionary Founder, Ermenegildo Zegna, who believed in creating world-class fabrics in harmony with both nature and local communities—a philosophy embodied by Oasi Zegna, the home of our values. The inspiration behind the brand’s values, Oasi Zegna, continues to guide everything we do at ZEGNA — from supporting our people to fostering a culture of growth, where craftsmanship and innovation are core elements of our learning processes and long-term growth strategy.  
  
**YOUR ROLE AT ZEGNA**  
  
As Operations Coordinator, based in New York, you will bring your unique strengths to the Operations Team, helping us support the day-to-day operations of the New York office stockroom and shipping/receiving area. This role is responsible for managing inbound and outbound shipments, maintaining stockroom organization and inventory accuracy, coordinating domestic and international logistics, and supporting retail store operations and special projects.  
  
You’ll work closely with the Director of Retail Operations to drive meaningful results and shape the way we work and grow**.** The position will also support the Senior Operations team with administrative and operational initiatives, including store support, event logistics, new store openings, and cross-functional office logistics. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining operational excellence, efficiency, and exceptional service across the business.  
  
**HOW YOU BRING IT TO LIFE**  
  
Here’s how you’ll bring this role to life each day — making it your own and shaping it with your unique talents and expertise:
  
  
**Shipping, Receiving & Logistics**

* Manage all inbound and outbound shipments for the office, retail stores, events, and operational teams
* Receive, process, organize, and distribute incoming deliveries
* Prepare and coordinate outgoing domestic and international shipments to stores, vendors, events, and partners
* Coordinate shipment tracking, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution as needed
* Prepare and manage export documentation, customs paperwork, and shipping documentation for international shipments
* Support logistics coordination for store needs, special projects, and operational initiatives
* Coordinate shipments, deliveries, and courier requests for the offsite tailor shop as needed
* Partner with Building Management and the Office Manager to coordinate freight elevator scheduling and property removal authorization processes

**Stockroom & Inventory Management**

* Maintain organization, cleanliness, and operational standards within the stockroom and shipping/receiving areas
* Monitor and manage inventory levels, ensuring accurate tracking of stock movement and storage
* Support inventory transfers, stock allocations, replenishment needs, and operational supply management
* Maintain accurate records of inventory movements for office and store support
* Communicate and escalate facility and maintenance issues within the office, stockroom, and shipping/receiving areas to the appropriate partners to ensure timely resolution

**PR & Corporate Office Support**

* Serve as the primary operational support partner for the PR team by coordinating daily inbound and outbound sample shipments
* Process urgent domestic and international shipments for editors, stylists, agencies, VIPs, and corporate partners while ensuring timely carrier collections
* Maintain a well-organized mailroom by clearly separating incoming and outgoing shipments, ensuring packages are accurately processed, labeled, and staged for collection
* Coordinate with courier and shipping providers to facilitate timely pickups, deliveries, and shipment tracking
* Prioritize time-sensitive requests while maintaining shipment accuracy and providing proactive communication on shipment status
* Maintain accurate shipping records and documentation to support traceability and minimize shipment delays or misplaced packages

**Store Operations & Event Support**

* Support new store openings, store projects, and retail operational initiatives
* Assist with special event stock management, shipment coordination, and logistical execution
* Coordinate operational supplies, fixtures, and inventory required for store openings, events, and projects
* Provide ongoing operational support to retail stores and field teams as needed

**Administrative & Team Support**

* Support the Senior Operations team with administrative tasks, reporting, and project coordination
* Assist in the preparation of the weekly Operations KPI report for retail stores
* Prepare operational reports and supporting materials for the Operations Director's store visits
* Support the processing and reconciliation of store inventory adjustments
* Maintain operational trackers, shipping records, and process documentation
* Communicate effectively with stores, vendors, carriers, and cross-functional partners
* Help identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, organization, and workflow processes

**WHO YOU ARE**  
  
This is how you show up:

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, logistics, inventory management, shipping/receiving, stockroom operations, or retail support preferred
* Experience coordinating domestic and international shipments preferred
* Familiarity with export documentation, customs requirements, and international shipping procedures is an asset
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting competing deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and inventory or retail management systems
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to lift and move packages,

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**

New York, NY. Hybrid, in person four days a week. Travel to Washington, DC with the founders a few times a quarter.

**The Role**

Kaizen's founders spend their weeks between New York, Washington and the agencies and partners in between, in rooms where decisions about public services get made. The company is scaling quickly, and the operating layer behind the founders hasn't kept pace: a trip gets booked at midnight, a dinner gets planned the morning of, an offsite comes together in a group chat. This role exists to own that layer for the CEO, the COO and the company: travel, scheduling, events, vendors and the hundred details that decide whether a week runs.

You'll work closer to the founders than almost anyone, with a front-row seat to how a company scaling this fast actually gets built. And because so little is set in stone yet, the systems you put in place now become how Kaizen operates as it grows.

**What You'll Do**

* Own travel end to end for the CEO and COO, especially the regular New York to DC rhythm: flights, trains, hotels, ground, and the plan B when something slips
* Run scheduling logistics with the Founders Associate: confirm, move and hold time, handle the back-and-forth with external offices, and make sure every meeting has a room, a link and the right people in it
* Be the main line between the founders and the rest of the company: keep the team current on where the CEO and COO are each week, when they're reachable, and the fastest way to get time or an approval from them
* Handle reservations, vendors, gifts, expenses and reimbursements for the founders, and keep the receipts and records clean
* Coordinate with office operations so the NYC space works for the team on heavy days: visitors, candidate onsites, customer visits and all-hands
* Build the systems that make the above repeatable, using AI tools as a first resort: templates, checklists, automations and a shared tracker the rest of the team can actually use
* Take on the problems that have no owner yet, solve them, and turn the recurring ones into systems, so the whole team can stay focused on the mission

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience supporting a founder, executive or small leadership team, and specific examples of what you took off their plate so it stayed off
* A working habit of using AI tools and automations to do the job faster, not as a novelty but as how you work day to day
* A track record of getting logistics right under time pressure and on short notice, with a plan B ready before anyone asks for it
* Reliability and responsiveness: when a founder is traveling and something breaks, you are the person who picks up
* Discretion with sensitive information, including investor, customer and personnel matters
* Pride in execution: you get energy from a week that runs without a hitch, and you know the details are where that happens

**Strong Candidates May Also...**

* Have worked in a high-growth environment, like an early-stage startup, where priorities shift week to week
* Have supported leaders who split time between two cities
* Have built or automated a workflow that a whole team adopted

**Don't Apply If...**

* You need someone to tell you the dinner is Thursday. You should already know, and have the reservation.
* You think AI tools are a shortcut rather than the way the job gets done now.
* You would rather manage a calendar than make sure the week it describes actually happens.

The founders are in rooms where decisions about public services get made. Your job is to make sure they get there, and that nothing about getting there is what they are thinking about.

----------------------

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm.
* Company-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us.
* Non-NYC employees: $100 per month, ded

jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

You will own our inventory from the shelf to the purchase order: knowing what we have, where it is, and what we need next. You will also be the first stop for purchase requests, researching products and suppliers so the team buys the right item at a fair price.

This role suits someone who likes putting things in order and keeping them that way, and who enjoys digging into specs, prices and lead times before recommending a purchase.

**Inventory management and organization**

* Keep accurate counts of parts, materials, tools and supplies in our inventory system.
* Receive incoming shipments, check them against the purchase order, and report shortages or damage.
* Label, bin and shelve items so anyone on the team can find them without asking.
* Design and maintain the storage layout, including bin locations and naming conventions.
* Run regular cycle counts and a full physical count on a set schedule, and resolve discrepancies.
* Set and monitor minimum stock levels, and flag items before they run out.
* Track tools and equipment that are checked out, and follow up on returns.
* Identify obsolete, excess or damaged stock and recommend what to do with it.
* Keep storage areas clean, safe and orderly.

**Purchase requests and research**

* Take in purchase requests from the team and clarify what is needed, by when, and why.
* Research options: compare specifications, price, availability, lead time, shipping cost and supplier reliability.
* Request and compare quotes from multiple vendors.
* Present a short recommendation with the options considered, so the approver can decide quickly.
* Create purchase orders once approved, and track them through delivery.
* Follow up with suppliers on late, incorrect or incomplete orders, and handle returns.
* Maintain vendor records, including contacts, pricing, terms and past performance.
* Look for savings through alternate sources, bulk pricing or substitutions that meet the same need.
* Match receipts to purchase orders so accounting can pay vendor bills without delay.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2+ years in inventory control, purchasing, warehouse, stockroom or a similar role.
* Strong organizational habits and attention to detail; your counts are right.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and with learning inventory or ERP software.
* Able to research unfamiliar products and summarize the options clearly in writing.
* Clear, professional communication with coworkers and suppliers.
* Able to work independently and follow through without reminders.
* Able to lift up to [50] lb and spend part of the day on your feet.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Odoo or another ERP system.
* Experience buying industrial, mechanical or electrical parts and reading spec sheets or drawings.
* Experience negotiating with vendors or arranging freight.
* Forklift certification.
* Barcode or label system setup experience.

Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week
